title: Key West After Dark, Ghost, Santeria & Voodoo Pedicab Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an eerie adventure through Key West's Old Town in a cozy pedicab, where the island's haunted past comes to life. As we roll through the narrow, historic streets, you'll hear chilling tales of ghostly encounters, from restless spirits who never left to eerie legends passed down through generations. We’ll pass by the famous haunted landmarks, including the Key West Cemetery, where some say the dead still walk at night, and the eerie corners of Old Town, known for their strange, unexplainable occurrences. With the breeze in your hair and the moonlight casting long shadows, prepare for a spine-tingling ride into the heart of Key West’s most mysterious and supernatural stories. Buckle up, it's going to be a night you won't forget!
